# uml reference: every diagram kind

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-skill-reference.mjs from `uml kinds` and `uml schema <kind>`; do not edit by hand. -->

One section per kind: what it draws, its backends (the first is the default),
the text formats it exports to and imports from, its top-level properties
(`*` marks required ones) and, for each list, the `type` values with the
properties each one requires. `uml schema <kind>` has every property with its
description; `uml example <kind>` prints a minimal valid model.

## class

Class diagram: Classes, interfaces, enumerations and their generalizations, realizations, associations, aggregations, compositions and dependencies.

- Backends: engine, plantuml. Exports to: plantuml, mermaid. Imports from: plantuml, mermaid.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 150): `class` (id, name), `interface` (id, name), `enumeration` (id, name), `datatype` (id, name), `primitive` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 300): `generalization` (from, to), `realization` (from, to), `association` (from, to), `aggregation` (from, to), `composition` (from, to), `dependency` (from, to), `containment` (from, to)

## object

Object diagram: Instance specifications with slot values and the links between them, a snapshot of a system at one moment.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `classifiers`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `classifiers[]` (up to 100): `name`*, `attributes`
- `elements[].type` (1 to 150): `instance` (id), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[]` (up to 300): `id`, `type`*, `from`*, `to`*, `name`, `association`, `fromEnd`, `toEnd`

## package

Package diagram: Packages with nested packages and classifiers, package import («import», «access»), package merge, dependencies and containment.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 150): `package` (id, name), `class` (id, name), `interface` (id, name), `enumeration` (id, name), `datatype` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 300): `import` (from, to), `access` (from, to), `merge` (from, to), `dependency` (from, to), `containment` (from, to)

## profile

Profile diagram: Profiles, stereotypes with tagged values, the metaclasses they extend, profile application and metaclass references.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 150): `profile` (id, name), `package` (id, name), `stereotype` (id, name), `metaclass` (id, name), `enumeration` (id, name), `class` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 300): `extension` (from, to), `generalization` (from, to), `apply` (from, to), `reference` (from, to)

## communication

Communication diagram: Lifelines connected by links, with numbered synchronous, asynchronous and reply messages listed along the links.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `lifelines`*, `links`, `messages`.
- `lifelines[]` (1 to 40): `id`*, `name`, `type`, `selector`, `multiObject`
- `links[]` (up to 80): `id`, `from`*, `to`*
- `messages[]` (up to 150): `id`, `sequence`*, `from`*, `to`*, `name`*, `arguments`, `assignTo`, `returnValue`, `guard`, `iteration`, `parallel`, `sort`

## interaction-overview

Interaction overview diagram: Control flow between interaction uses (ref frames) and inline interactions (sd frames), with decisions, merges, forks, joins and final nodes.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `lifelines`, `nodes`*, `flows`.
- `nodes[].type` (1 to 60): `initial` (id), `final` (id), `flow-final` (id), `decision` (id), `merge` (id), `fork` (id), `join` (id), `interaction-use` (id, name), `interaction` (id, name, lifelines, messages)
- `flows[]` (up to 120): `id`, `from`*, `to`*, `guard`

## component

Component diagram: Components with ports, provided and required interfaces (lollipops and sockets), assembly and delegation connectors, nested parts, interfaces, artifacts and manifestations.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 80): `component` (id, name), `class` (id, name), `interface` (id, name), `artifact` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 150): `assembly` (from, to, interface), `delegation` (from, to), `realization` (from, to), `usage` (from, to), `manifest` (from, to), `dependency` (from, to)

## deployment

Deployment diagram: Nodes, devices and execution environments with deployed artifacts and deployment specifications, communication paths, «deploy» and «manifest» dependencies.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 80): `node` (id, name), `device` (id, name), `executionEnvironment` (id, name), `artifact` (id, name), `deploymentSpecification` (id, name), `component` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 150): `communicationPath` (from, to), `deploy` (from, to), `manifest` (from, to), `dependency` (from, to)

## composite-structure

Composite structure diagram: Structured classes with parts, reference properties and ports, connectors with end names and multiplicities, collaborations with roles and collaboration uses.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 40): `class` (id, name), `collaboration` (id, name, roles), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 150): `connector` (from, to), `dependency` (from, to)

## sequence

Sequence diagram: Lifelines and the messages between them in time order, with activations, creation and destruction, combined fragments, interaction uses, state invariants and notes.

- Backends: plantuml. Exports to: plantuml, mermaid. Imports from: plantuml, mermaid.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `autonumber`, `lifelines`*, `items`*.
- `lifelines[]` (1 to 30): `id`*, `name`, `classifier`, `symbol`
- `items[].type` (1 to 300): `message` (sort, from, to), `found` (sort, to), `lost` (sort, from), `activate` (lifeline), `deactivate` (lifeline), `destroy` (lifeline), `stateInvariant` (lifeline, constraint), `note` (position, lifelines, text), `ref` (covered, name), `fragment` (operator, operands)

## timing

Timing diagram: State and value changes of lifelines along a time axis (robust and concise notation), with messages, duration and time constraints, highlighted intervals and notes.

- Backends: plantuml. Exports to: plantuml. Imports from: none.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `timeUnit`*, `lifelines`*, `messages`, `durationConstraints`, `timeConstraints`, `highlights`, `notes`.
- `lifelines[]` (1 to 20): `id`*, `name`, `classifier`, `notation`*, `states`*, `changes`*
- `messages[]` (up to 100): `id`, `from`*, `fromTime`*, `to`*, `toTime`*, `name`*, `arguments`
- `durationConstraints[]` (up to 40): `id`, `lifeline`*, `from`*, `to`*, `min`*, `max`*
- `timeConstraints[]` (up to 20): `id`, `lifeline`*, `at`*, `from`*, `to`*
- `highlights[]` (up to 20): `id`, `from`*, `to`*, `label`
- `notes[]` (up to 40): `id`, `lifeline`*, `at`*, `position`, `text`*

## activity

Activity diagram: Actions, object nodes, signals, decisions and merges, forks and joins, loops and partitions (swimlanes) of a well-structured flow.

- Backends: plantuml. Exports to: plantuml, mermaid. Imports from: plantuml.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `partitions`, `nodes`*, `edges`*.
- `partitions[]` (1 to 8): `id`*, `name`*
- `nodes[].type` (1 to 200): `action` (id, name), `callBehavior` (id, name), `sendSignal` (id, name), `acceptEvent` (id, name), `object` (id, name), `initial` (id), `activityFinal` (id), `flowFinal` (id), `decision` (id), `merge` (id), `fork` (id), `join` (id)
- `edges[]` (1 to 300): `id`, `type`, `from`*, `to`*, `guard`

## state-machine

State machine diagram: States with entry/do/exit behaviors, composite states with orthogonal regions, submachine states, all pseudostates and transitions labeled trigger [guard] / effect.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml, mermaid. Imports from: plantuml, mermaid.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `transitions`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 120): `state` (id, name), `initial` (id), `final` (id), `choice` (id), `junction` (id), `fork` (id), `join` (id), `shallowHistory` (id), `deepHistory` (id), `terminate` (id), `note` (id, text)
- `transitions[]` (up to 250): `id`, `from`*, `to`*, `trigger`, `guard`, `effect`

## use-case

Use case diagram: Actors and use cases in a subject boundary, with associations, «include», «extend» (extension points and conditions) and generalizations.

- Backends: engine. Exports to: plantuml, mermaid. Imports from: plantuml.
- Top level: `kind`*, `title`, `elements`*, `relationships`.
- `elements[].type` (1 to 120): `actor` (id, name), `useCase` (id, name), `subject` (id, name), `note` (id, text)
- `relationships[].type` (up to 250): `association` (from, to), `include` (from, to), `extend` (from, to, extensionPoint), `generalization` (from, to)
